answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks a gale of fake identities. Only 200 work slots open per epoch; an agent claims one by burning a 40-unit deposit, tied to one vertex in the work graph, so one identity cannot hold many slots. Dropping a slot forfeits the deposit; a new claim needs a fresh burn. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 units, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards, like one pearl.
